title: ACIS semantic-reader admission and NIST corpus path
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and implementation-readiness refinement

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The worktree was already broadly modified and uncommitted. This research pass edited only the parity plan and this receipt; it did not modify codec or test source.

sources.project: cq-acis pinned release and local exact-artifact observation
sources.observation: The existing pinned 0.3.12 receipt records one generated SAB 21800 box converted to a valid closed OCCT solid with bounded geometry metrics and complete classified raw-record disposition. It explicitly marks qualification ineligible because the source was ezdxf-authored, runtime attestation is version-strings-only, the vector is one generated polyhedron, the shape kernel is OCCT, and no outer DWG/AcDs association was exercised.
sources.planDisposition: Reuse this baseline; do not rerun or widen its support claim. Keep bare-payload semantics separate from file carrier, DWG owner/key association, native FreeCAD behavior, and kernel independence.

sources.project: cq-acis mutable current documentation and pinned corpus
sources.observation: Current docs distinguish SAT save versions 105/400/600/700, SAB 21800, and selected ASM 22000-23200 profiles, with geometry/profile limitations, raw retention, and explicit conversion failures. Some geometry details are marked unreleased. The corpus uses pinned upstream commit/blob/hash/license metadata and includes NIST SAT variants plus ezdxf-produced fixtures.
sources.planDisposition: Do not apply mutable current-main or unreleased capabilities retroactively to cq-acis 0.3.12. Use at most one hash- and license-checked NIST artifact in scratch after exact pinned-package profile admission; do not commit that artifact.

sources.observation: NIST describes the model repository as a public-domain-in-the-US-oriented collection intended in part for CAD compatibility and translation research, supplied as-is, and warns that third-party assignments or foreign rights may apply.
sources.planDisposition: Treat a sample as a provenance-rich candidate, not as an automatically trusted geometry oracle. Review the exact per-sample notice and determine independent expected geometry before claiming semantic parity.

sources.observation: The public OCCT component catalog identifies ACIS SAT/SAB and DXF exchange translators as commercial extensions, separate from the open-source OCCT core.
sources.planDisposition: Do not infer built-in ACIS support from an OCCT-based consumer and do not add a purchased component as a dependency. An already-authorized component is optional same-kernel-family evidence only.

sources.observation: FreeCAD documentation and issue discussion say its stock DXF import path does not read embedded ACIS/SAT solids; its DWG route converts to DXF before that importer.
sources.planDisposition: Keep explicit entity/mesh acceptance and stock FreeCAD ACIS behavior separate. Classify unsupported stock import as UNSUPPORTED_CONSUMER, not as codec loss or semantic success.

implementationReadiness.defaultAction: Reuse the existing exact cq-acis 0.3.12 local observation, then consider one pinned NIST SAT corpus artifact only if its exact source profile is admitted; do not install a peer or add a default dependency.
sequence: Verify the exact corpus source commit/blob ID, SHA-256, file size, and per-sample license notice before using a NIST SAT candidate.

Select the smallest compatible sample whose entire body-reachable geometry can be classified by the pinned cq-acis artifact; otherwise record NOT_QUALIFIED and continue with generated scratch controls.
Keep original NIST bytes and all derived DXF/DWG artifacts in a unique temporary directory; never commit external fixtures.
For a supported inline-SAT roundtrip, compare carrier bytes/order and entity/block ownership before attempting semantic conversion.

Require independent expected geometry, complete record disposition, valid closed topology where expected, and explicit units/tolerances before calling the result semantic parity; otherwise report only carrier preservation or shape construction.
Do not use this bare-payload route to claim ACDSDATA key/owner closure, native FreeCAD support, arbitrary ACIS coverage, or resolution of any deferred J item.
Keep implementation checks fast: owning local selector per code slice; optional semantic-peer execution only at the composed checkpoint; update the plan and self-unblock after each item.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No downloaded NIST or peer artifacts are committed; scratch-only use requires source pin, hash verification, and license review.
implementationReadiness.progressPolicy: Research only; no implementation slice was performed in this receipt. Continue the active implementation goal separately and report progress after each committed slice.

limitations: No NIST sample was downloaded or executed. Current cq-acis main documentation is mutable and contains unreleased capability notes; 0.3.12 is the latest PyPI release identified in this research and the only candidate with an exact local run receipt. OCCT kernel family is shared with CadQuery/FreeCAD Part; stock FreeCAD DXF import is not an ACIS semantic reader. J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
